answer_4.quote: we conducted a manual assessment of 100 automated CADs for each CAD generation technique for each construct, i.e., 300 CADs for sexism and 300 for hate speech. Two of the paper's authors manually and independently labeled the CADs without looking at the original instance.
answer_4.guideline: Label the CADs as sexist or non-sexist (for sexism) or hate or not hate (for hate speech) to determine if the label was flipped correctly.
